answer.explanation: The live configuration of CrudApiFunction sets TABLE_NAME=missing-table; the function was last modified at 17:52:04, just before the window. The committed SAM template sets TABLE_NAME to !Ref CartTable, so the live value has drifted from the intended state. No commit in the window changed this, so the change was made outside the repository. Every CrudApi invocation in the window fails with AccessDeniedException on PutItem against table/missing-table. The error is a side effect of the wrong table name, not a missing permission: CrudApiRole grants PutItem on the CartTable ARN, which does not match missing-table. The IAM layer is therefore not the root cause.
